summary: Defines SNMP managed objects for the Label Distribution Protocol (LDP), which MPLS routers use to tell each other which labels to use. It lets operators monitor LDP sessions, peers and label mappings, and configure some of them, using standard management tools.

eli5.summary: Routers agree on little sticker codes for packages by chatting with neighbors. This document defines a standard report card so a manager can see who is chatting and what codes they agreed on.

questions: how to monitor mpls label distribution protocol with snmp
